ideas.title: The Salary Reveal
ideas.slide1_hook: How much do GA graduates earn?
ideas.slide2_reveal: Singapore tech salary statistics — entry, mid, senior tier breakdowns
ideas.cta: Comment 'SALARY' for the full Singapore tech pay report.
ideas.caption:
Curious what a career switch into tech actually pays in Singapore? 💼

NodeFlair's 2026 Singapore tech salary data shows junior engineers earning ~S$4.8K/mo, mid-career S$7K+, and AI-fluent engineers commanding 18-25% pay premiums across every tier.

The numbers anchor everything: courses to pick, how aggressively to switch, what 'success' looks like 12 months in. Worth knowing before the curriculum, not after.

Comment 'SALARY' for the full Singapore tech pay breakdown.

ideas.title: The Secret Skill
ideas.slide1_hook: The #1 skill tech recruiters in Singapore want
ideas.slide2_reveal: Soft skills + Technical proficiency + AI literacy
ideas.cta: DM us 'SKILL' for our free skill-gap diagnostic.
ideas.caption:
Singapore tech recruiters keep saying the same thing — and it isn't 'more Python.' 🎯

Per HRM Asia, AI literacy is the hardest-to-find skill (25% of employers struggle to find it) but 34% still cite adaptability and work ethic as the top soft-skill differentiators. The candidates getting hired in 2026 stack both: technical depth + AI fluency + the human stuff.

If you're upskilling on tech alone, you're optimising the wrong axis.

DM us 'SKILL' for our free skill-gap diagnostic.

source.label: HRM Asia — AI literacy is Singapore's hardest-to-find skill

slide2.headline: The Hiring Trifecta
stats: AI literacy: 25% of SG employers can't find it
Soft skills: 34% rank adaptability + work ethic top
